search.query: | inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | stats count by framework | sort framework
| inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | stats count by capability | sort capability
| inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=replace(datamodel," ","_") | stats count by datamodel | sort datamodel
$base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | stats count by group_value | sort group_value

$base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | eval selected_group=if(len("$selected_group$")=0,"*","$selected_group$") | eval selected_group_wrapped="|" . selected_group . "|" | where selected_group="*" OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|" . group_value . "|%") | fields group_value * | fields - _raw _time _indextime _cd _serial linecount punct splunk_server splunk_server_group | untable group_value field_name field_value | where isnotnull(field_value) | eval field_name=lower(field_name) | where NOT match(field_name,"^_") | where field_name!="group_value" | stats count as field_instances by group_value field_name | join type=inner max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | eval datamodel=replace(datamodel," ","_") | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval field_name=lower(field_name) | fields datamodel field_name ] | fields group_value field_name field_instances datamodel

| stats sum(field_instances) as field_instances dc(field_name) as matched_fields values(field_name) as matched_field_names dc(group_value) as group_count values(group_value) as groups by datamodel | eval datamodel_observed=1 | append [ | inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | eval selected_framework=if(len("$framework_filter$")=0,"*","$framework_filter$") | eval selected_framework_wrapped="|" . selected_framework . "|" | where selected_framework="*" OR like(selected_framework_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_framework_wrapped,"%|" . framework . "|%") | eval selected_capability=if(len("$capability_filter$")=0,"*","$capability_filter$") | eval selected_capability_wrapped="|" . selected_capability . "|" | where selected_capability="*" OR like(selected_capability_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_capability_wrapped,"%|" . capability . "|%") | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | eval mapping_row=1 | fields framework framework_version control_reference requirement_area capability datamodel governance_relevance mapping_confidence source_terms mapping_rationale source_url notes mapping_row ] | eventstats max(datamodel_observed) as datamodel_observed max(matched_fields) as matched_fields max(field_instances) as field_instances values(matched_field_names) as matched_field_names values(groups) as groups by datamodel | where mapping_row=1 | eval datamodel_observed=coalesce(datamodel_observed,0) | eval coverage_state=if(datamodel_observed=1,"Covered","Missing") | eval selected_coverage=if(len("$coverage_filter$")=0,"*","$coverage_filter$") | where selected_coverage="*" OR coverage_state=selected_coverage | eval mapping_weight=case(mapping_confidence="High",1,mapping_confidence="Medium",0.75,mapping_confidence="Low",0.5,true(),0.75) | eval covered_weight=if(datamodel_observed=1,mapping_weight,0) | fields framework framework_version control_reference requirement_area capability datamodel governance_relevance mapping_confidence source_terms mapping_rationale source_url notes datamodel_observed coverage_state mapping_weight covered_weight matched_fields field_instances matched_field_names groups

| join type=left max=0 field_name datamodel [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval datamodel=replace(datamodel," ","_") | eval recommended=if(recommended="1" OR recommended=1 OR recommended="true",1,0) | where recommended=1 | eval is_recommended=1 | fields datamodel field_name is_recommended ] | where is_recommended=1 | stats dc(field_name) as observed_recommended sum(field_instances) as field_instances by datamodel | append [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | eval datamodel=replace(datamodel," ","_") | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="1" OR recommended=1 OR recommended="true",1,0) | where recommended=1 | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | stats dc(field_name) as total_recommended by datamodel | eval catalog_row=1 ] | eventstats values(observed_recommended) as observed_recommended values(field_instances) as field_instances by datamodel | where catalog_row=1 | eval observed_recommended=coalesce(tonumber(observed_recommended),0) | eval total_recommended=tonumber(total_recommended) | eval dm_coverage_pct=if(total_recommended>0,round(100*observed_recommended/total_recommended,1),null()) | fields datamodel observed_recommended total_recommended dm_coverage_pct field_instances

| fields datamodel dm_coverage_pct observed_recommended total_recommended | append [ | inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | eval selected_framework=if(len("$framework_filter$")=0,"*","$framework_filter$") | eval selected_framework_wrapped="|" . selected_framework . "|" | where selected_framework="*" OR like(selected_framework_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_framework_wrapped,"%|" . framework . "|" | where selected_capability="*" OR like(selected_capability_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_capability_wrapped,"%|" . capability . "|%") | eval selected_dm=if(len("$datamodel_filter$")=0,"*","$datamodel_filter$") | eval selected_dm_wrapped="|" . selected_dm . "|" | eval datamodel=replace(datamodel," ","_") | where selected_dm="*" OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_dm_wrapped,"%|" . datamodel . "|%") | where governance_relevance="High" | where datamodel!="Ticket_Management" | eval map_row=1 | fields framework framework_version control_reference capability datamodel map_row ] | eventstats values(dm_coverage_pct) as dm_coverage_pct values(observed_recommended) as observed_recommended values(total_recommended) as total_recommended by datamodel | where map_row=1 | eval dm_coverage_pct=if(isnotnull(total_recommended),coalesce(tonumber(dm_coverage_pct),0),null()) | stats max(dm_coverage_pct) as control_coverage_pct values(datamodel) as primary_datamodel values(observed_recommended) as observed_recommended values(total_recommended) as total_recommended values(capability) as capability by framework framework_version control_reference | where isnotnull(control_coverage_pct) | eval evidence_band=case( control_coverage_pct>=70, "Good Coverage", control_coverage_pct>=40, "Partial Coverage", control_coverage_pct>0, "Low Coverage", true(), "No Coverage" ) | fields framework framework_version control_reference capability primary_datamodel observed_recommended total_recommended control_coverage_pct evidence_band

| stats dc(control_reference) as primary_controls dc(eval(if(evidence_band="Good Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as good_controls dc(eval(if(evidence_band="Partial Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as partial_controls dc(eval(if(evidence_band="Low Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as low_controls dc(eval(if(evidence_band="No Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as none_controls avg(control_coverage_pct) as avg_coverage_pct dc(eval(if(control_coverage_pct>0,primary_datamodel,null()))) as matched_datamodels dc(framework) as frameworks | eval avg_coverage_pct=round(avg_coverage_pct,1) | fields primary_controls good_controls partial_controls low_controls none_controls avg_coverage_pct matched_datamodels frameworks

| eval datamodel_observed=1 | join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup governance_datamodel_mapping_lookup | eval selected_framework=if(len("$framework_filter$")=0,"*","$framework_filter$") | eval selected_framework_wrapped="|" . selected_framework . "|" | where selected_framework="*" OR like(selected_framework_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_framework_wrapped,"%|" . framework . "|%") | fields framework framework_version control_reference requirement_area capability datamodel governance_relevance mapping_confidence source_terms mapping_rationale source_url notes ] | eval governance_mapped=if(isnotnull(framework),1,0) | eval coverage_state=if(governance_mapped=1,"Covered","Unmapped") | where "$coverage_filter$"="*" OR ("$coverage_filter$"="Covered" AND governance_mapped=1) OR ("$coverage_filter$"="Missing" AND governance_mapped=0) | where "$governance_relevance_filter$"="*" OR governance_relevance="$governance_relevance_filter$" | eval mapping_weight=case(mapping_confidence="High",1,mapping_confidence="Medium",0.75,mapping_confidence="Low",0.5,true(),0.75) | fields group_value field_name field_instances datamodel framework framework_version control_reference requirement_area capability governance_relevance mapping_confidence source_terms mapping_rationale source_url notes governance_mapped coverage_state mapping_weight

div.div: Filtered investigation of control completeness, capability coverage, mapping explainability, and source guidance. Potential evidence only, not compliance.

div.p: What this shows: Completeness-band mix for High-relevance primary controls after the current IN filters.
Read it as: Investigation context for the selected framework, capability, source, and relevance filters. Not the executive framework gap chart.

search.query: | stats count as controls by evidence_band | eval band_order=case(evidence_band="Good Coverage",1,evidence_band="Partial Coverage",2,evidence_band="Low Coverage",3,evidence_band="No Coverage",4,true(),5) | sort band_order | fields - band_order

div.p: What this shows: Average recommended-field completeness for High-relevance primary controls grouped by DIG capability.
Read it as: Same scoring model as control bands (not “any CIM field present”). Thin shared-field hits stay Low / Partial instead of looking fully covered.

search.query: | stats avg(control_coverage_pct) as capability_coverage_pct dc(control_reference) as controls values(primary_datamodel) as primary_datamodels dc(eval(if(evidence_band="Good Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as good_controls dc(eval(if(evidence_band="Partial Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as partial_controls dc(eval(if(evidence_band="Low Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as low_controls dc(eval(if(evidence_band="No Coverage",control_reference,null()))) as none_controls by capability | eval capability_coverage_pct=round(capability_coverage_pct,1) | eval status=case( capability_coverage_pct>=70, "Good Coverage", capability_coverage_pct>=40, "Partial Coverage", capability_coverage_pct>0, "Low Coverage", true(), "No Coverage" ) | eval band_mix=good_controls . "G / " . partial_controls . "P / " . low_controls . "L / " . none_controls . "N" | rename capability as Capability capability_coverage_pct as "Recommended %" status as Status controls as Controls primary_datamodels as "Primary Datamodels" band_mix as "Control bands" | table Capability "Recommended %" Status Controls "Primary Datamodels" "Control bands" | sort - "Recommended %" Capability

div.p: What this shows: Each High-relevance primary control with its mapped datamodel, recommended-field hit rate, and Good / Partial / Low / No Coverage band.
Read it as: Use this to explain why a filtered band mix or capability average is high or low. Potential evidence only.

search.query: | eval recommended_hits=observed_recommended . " / " . total_recommended | rename framework as Framework control_reference as Control primary_datamodel as "Primary Datamodel" control_coverage_pct as "Recommended %" evidence_band as Band recommended_hits as "Recommended fields" capability as Capability | table Framework Control Capability "Primary Datamodel" "Recommended fields" "Recommended %" Band | sort Framework - "Recommended %" Control

panel.title: Framework to Capability to Datamodel Evidence

div.p: What this shows: Explainability chain from framework/control to capability, datamodel, observed evidence, and rationale.
How to use it: Answer how a control or capability score was produced for the current filters.

search.query: | eval evidence=if(datamodel_observed=1,"Observed","Not observed") | eval matched_fields=coalesce(matched_fields,0) | rename framework as Framework control_reference as Control capability as Capability datamodel as Datamodel evidence as Evidence mapping_confidence as Confidence mapping_rationale as Rationale matched_fields as "Matched Fields" | table Framework Control Capability Datamodel Evidence Confidence "Matched Fields" Rationale | sort Framework Control Capability Datamodel

div.p: What this shows: Per Data Source mapping coverage, relevance, mapped vs unmapped datamodels, and a short consultant talking point.
Read it as: Merged assessment and recommendation view for the selected sources. Mapping evidence only, not compliance.

search.query: | stats dc(field_name) as matched_dm_fields dc(datamodel) as matched_datamodel_count dc(eval(if(governance_mapped=1,datamodel,null()))) as mapped_datamodel_count dc(eval(if(governance_mapped=0,datamodel,null()))) as unmapped_datamodel_count values(framework) as frameworks values(capability) as capabilities values(eval(if(governance_mapped=1,datamodel,null()))) as governance_mapped_datamodels values(eval(if(governance_mapped=0,datamodel,null()))) as unmapped_datamodels values(governance_relevance) as relevance_values max(governance_mapped) as governance_mapped by group_value | eval mapping_coverage_pct=if(matched_datamodel_count>0,round((mapped_datamodel_count/matched_datamodel_count)*100,1),0) | eval frameworks=if(isnull(frameworks),"Unmapped",frameworks) | eval capabilities=if(isnull(capabilities),"Unmapped",capabilities) | eval high_relevance=if(mvfind(relevance_values,"High")>=0,1,0) | eval medhigh_relevance=if(mvfind(relevance_values,"Medium-High")>=0,1,0) | eval medium_relevance=if(mvfind(relevance_values,"Medium")>=0,1,0) | eval governance_relevance=case( governance_mapped=0, "Unmapped", high_relevance=1, "High", medhigh_relevance=1, "Medium-High", medium_relevance=1, "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | eval guidance=case( governance_mapped=0, "Mapping opportunity: CIM relevance found, but no governance framework mapping is configured for these datamodels.", governance_relevance="High", "Lead with operational importance: highly relevant to security, audit or investigation outcomes. Validate ownership and use cases.", governance_relevance="Medium-High", "Strong candidate for governance review: evidence exists, confirm business use.", mapping_coverage_pct>=80, "Most detected datamodel relevance is mapped. Good starting point for framework-evidence conversations.", mapping_coverage_pct>=40, "Partial mapping coverage. Review unmapped datamodels before final decisions.", true(), "Limited mapping coverage. Prioritise mapping expansion and policy discussion." ) | rename group_value as "Data Source" mapping_coverage_pct as "Mapping %" governance_relevance as Relevance matched_dm_fields as "Matched fields" governance_mapped_datamodels as Mapped unmapped_datamodels as Unmapped | table "Data Source" Relevance "Mapping %" frameworks capabilities Mapped Unmapped "Matched fields" guidance | sort Relevance - "Mapping %" "Data Source"

div.p: What this shows: Datamodel-level evidence for selected sources: mapping state, frameworks, capabilities, and matched field counts.
Read it as: Why a source looks governance-relevant at the CIM model layer.

search.query: | stats dc(field_name) as matched_fields values(framework) as frameworks values(capability) as capabilities values(governance_relevance) as governance_relevance max(governance_mapped) as governance_mapped by group_value datamodel | eval mapping_state=if(governance_mapped=1,"Mapped","Unmapped") | eval frameworks=if(isnull(frameworks),"Unmapped",frameworks) | eval capabilities=if(isnull(capabilities),"Unmapped",capabilities) | rename group_value as "Data Source" datamodel as Datamodel matched_fields as Fields governance_relevance as Relevance | table "Data Source" Datamodel mapping_state frameworks capabilities Fields Relevance | sort "Data Source" mapping_state - Fields Datamodel

div.p: What this shows: Individual CIM fields driving observed datamodel evidence, with the frameworks and capabilities they support.
Read it as: Forensic field list for mapping validation. Prefer filtering by source or datamodel first.

search.query: | where datamodel_observed=1 | mvexpand matched_field_names | rename matched_field_names as field_name groups as "Data Source values" framework as Framework capability as Capability datamodel as Datamodel | stats values(Framework) as Frameworks values(Capability) as Capabilities values(Datamodel) as Datamodels values("Data Source values") as "Data Source values" by field_name | eval source_type_count=mvcount('Data Source values') | rename field_name as Field source_type_count as "Data Source Count" | table Field "Data Source Count" Datamodels Capabilities Frameworks "Data Source values" | sort - "Data Source Count" Field | head 100
